meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: Conversational AI financial advisor apps — chat-based stock picks and AI-assisted trade execution

analysis.summary: Almost nobody publishes fresh content on conversational AI investing. Walnut leads on volume with broker comparisons, while Clera has no pages and no recent activity in this data.

points.text: Walnut is the only rival with a clear content push: 7 new comparison pages aimed at beginners in seven regions.
Public.com published 19 new pages in 30 days. Only two are visible, and one is a how-to on its AI tool, Meta Muse.
Magnifi, Titan and Composer show no new pages. Magnifi updated one AI research explainer. Titan has no pages in the data.

Public.com.play: Teaches its AI assistant Meta Muse and offers a cash-versus-Treasuries calculator tool.

Titan.play: No pages found in the data, so no visible content play.

Walnut.play: Mass-produces stock and ETF pages, plus beginner broker comparisons for seven regions.

Magnifi.play: Keeps one explainer on AI stock research tools fresh. Little new publishing.

Composer.play: Large library of ETF and trading-strategy pages. No new or updated pages in 30 days.

Clera.play: No pages and no activity found in the data.

shared.title: Beginner and comparison pages
shared.text: Walnut publishes 7 beginner broker comparisons, and Composer has 145 ETF comparison pages. Both help people choose, and neither centres on conversational AI.

shared.title: Bulk programmatic pages
shared.text: Walnut (/stocks/ 10194, /etf/ 2210) and Composer (/etf/ 3230, /trading-strategies/ 1386) rely on templated pages for scale. Clera can't win on volume, so it should win on depth.

shared.title: AI explainers
shared.text: Public.com explains trading with Meta Muse and Magnifi explains AI stock research tools. Each has only one page, so this is a weak signal.

gaps.title: Chat-based stock picks, explained
gaps.text: Only Magnifi and Public.com have one AI page each. Nobody shows step by step how to get a pick from a chat and judge it.

gaps.title: AI trade execution safety
gaps.text: No rival covers how AI-assisted trades are placed, checked and controlled. Retail investors likely worry about this, and a clear guide could build trust.

gaps.title: AI advisor app comparisons
gaps.text: Walnut compares brokers but not conversational AI apps. A fair side-by-side of Clera, Public.com and Magnifi is open.

versus.Public.com: Has 520 pages and 19 new in 30 days, including an AI how-to and a calculator. Clera has no visible pages.
versus.Titan: Also shows no pages in the data, so Clera is not behind it on content.
versus.Walnut: Far larger at 14305 pages, with 7 new beginner comparisons. Clera has nothing comparable, but Walnut doesn't cover conversational AI.
versus.Magnifi: Has 269 pages and one updated AI research explainer. It is closest to Clera's niche, and Clera shows no content.
versus.Composer: Has 4972 pages, mostly templated ETF and strategy pages, with no recent activity. Clera has no visible library.
